descriptions: Information on leisure behaviour of the Dutch population regarding short holidays and day trips. Description of all recreational day trips ( P0752c ) and short holidays ( P0752b ) made by respondent during the spring and summer of 1982 / destination, activities, transport, distances, company, time spent / P0752b: overnight stays, reservations and arrangements made. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ housing situation/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ consumption of durables/ organizational membership
